result_preview.title: Service Health Metrics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregated ITSM performance analytics tracking ticket resolution times, equipment availability, and change success rates.
result_preview.description: This analytical data product aggregates key performance indicators across the ITSM domain, including mean time to resolution (MTTR) for service tickets, equipment uptime percentages, and change request success rates. It enables operations teams and service managers to monitor service quality trends, identify bottlenecks in request fulfillment, and optimize resource allocation for incident response and change management processes.

result_preview.title: Incident Root Cause Analysis Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously analyzes service tickets to identify root causes and recommend preventive actions.
result_preview.description: This agent automatically processes high-priority service tickets to perform root cause analysis by correlating incident patterns, examining related IT equipment status, and linking to historical change requests. It generates diagnostic reports and suggests preventive measures to reduce ticket recurrence, enabling faster resolution and improved service quality.

result_preview.title: Change Request Approval Workflow API
result_preview.shortDescription: REST API for managing change request approvals, scheduling, and impact assessment.
result_preview.description: Exposes change request lifecycle management including approval routing, scheduling validation, and rollback planning. Enables IT governance teams to automate change controls and track approval chains across dependent service tickets and IT equipment impacts.
